attributes.action: Make it optional to go to school when there is an amber/red warning.
attributes.additional_details: We should be able to choose if we want to come to school when there is a amber/red watning issued like a intense heat wave that goes up to near ten 40°C mark. This is so we do not absolutely get a heat stroke from the immense heat or if it is a storm we donot get swept off our feet. If you sign this petiton lots of kids in the uk will be happy not getting baked in the sun or getting absolutely swept off their feet or thunderd by heavy precipitation.
attributes.background: When met office issues a amber/red warning parents should have the option to send their kid to school or not.This is so that some people with health problems like eczema might start getting flares from the heat or sun.We should have the right to decide to come to school or not during this situation.
